key_decisions.decision: Keeps the LORD and ancestral inheritance as grounds for refusal.
Preserves Ahab’s retelling, including its omission of ancestral inheritance.
Keeps the royal challenge as a question, with alternative force noted.
Renders bless as the contextual euphemism curse, explicitly noted.
Keeps false testimony attributed and killing explicit.
Keeps murder accusation and place-specific blood judgment.
Marks the shift into divine first-person speech and retains coarse idiom.
Retains rampart from this pin rather than importing a plot of land.
Retains acknowledged humility and deferred, not canceled, judgment.
